description: List the projects in Recently deleted as { id, name, trashedAt, purgeAt, deletedBy, canEdit } entries. Each can be restored with restore_project until purgeAt (epoch ms), 30 days after it was deleted. `deletedBy` is { kind: "you" | "person" | "agent", label }: the caller, a teammate (label is their email), or a connected assistant (label is its name). `canEdit` says whether the caller may restore it. By default lists the caller's own personal projects; pass `workspaceId` (from list_workspaces) for that workspace's.

workspaceId.description: Optional workspace id (from list_workspaces). When given, lists that workspace's deleted projects instead of the caller's personal ones; requires membership.
